title: AI and the Everything in the Whole Wide World Benchmark
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally a critique of the ethics of AI evaluation. It examines the values embedded in benchmark creation and use, arguing that the pursuit of 'general' benchmarks leads to ethically problematic outcomes like metric chasing, masking of biases, and the misdirection of research. This focus on the moral and societal implications of evaluation practices makes it directly related to ethics in AI.
